The loop that outlives launch day

Launching a token is a commodity. Keeping people around is not. Totem is the engine for the part after the chart.

01 LAUNCH
Deploy a token with its DNA attached from block one.
02 HOLD
Time-weighted balance, not a one-block snapshot.
03 QUEST
Social, onchain and real-world challenges.
04 MINT
Eligibility proof unlocks the base segment.
05 EVOLVE
Behavior picks the branch your totem grows into.
06 FUND
Fees flow back into prizes, treasury and builders.

Three ways a culture begins

Token-first
token → eligibility → NFT → utility
A memecoin catches fire, then opens its NFT universe to proven holders.
NFT-first
NFT → token allocation → quests → evolution
An existing collection mints a token whose holders feed back into the art.
Event-first
event → ritual → collectible → record
A football upset, a viral moment or a meetup becomes a permanent artifact that reacts to verified outcomes.

The culture engine

SDK · CONTRACTS · TEMPLATES
A1
Community DNA
An onchain constitution: theme, eligibility, evolution paths, fee routes, seasons and decay rules.
A2
Holder identity
Hold time, quests, seasons and reputation. Borrow tokens for one block and you get nothing.
A3
Evolution trees
Branching paths: Diamond Holder, Liquidity Guardian, Meme Commander, Community Builder.
A4
Arena
Community versus community: meme tournaments, raids, prediction rounds and alliances.
A5
Trait market
Artists publish new segments, communities vote them live, revenue splits with the treasury.
A6
Event oracle
Verified outcomes rewrite metadata: match results, price milestones, charity targets.
FEE ROUTER

Every swap feeds the culture, in public.

Creators set percentage routes at launch. Every split is accounted onchain and visible on the community page. Rewards are tied to participation and community budgets, not promised yield.
